title: Centralize pure profile compatibility
description: Implement one authoritative pure compatibility operation returning a versioned status, ordered structured reasons, required confirmations, and recalibration requirement.
acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent normalized requests return deeply equivalent CompatibilityResult values without side effects
The result includes versioned status, stable ordered reason codes, required confirmations, and recalibration flag
Exact assumptions produce the documented compatible outcome and no mismatch reason
No UI, repository, preview, or renderer-specific state is read by the operation

steps.details: Add versioned serializable CompatibilityRequest, CompatibilityStatus, CompatibilityReason, required-confirmation, and CompatibilityResult contracts.
Compare normalized current assumptions with the profile in a deterministic field order and derive status, reasons, confirmations, and recalibration requirement.
Use explicit reason codes and canonical ordering so UI and persisted results do not depend on object or traversal order.
Add contract tests for exact assumptions, repeated calls, input immutability, serialization, and stable ordering.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; keep the evaluator to exact normalized comparison and focused contracts.
Compatibility is a software comparison of recorded assumptions, never a printer query or suitability proof.
Keep this operation framework-neutral and side-effect-free.
